description: Pikachu is a loyal and brave Electric-type Mouse Pokemon, best known as Ash Ketchum's primary companion. It stores electricity in its red cheek pouches and communicates by saying variations of its name. While generally cheerful, energetic, and kind, Pikachu can also be stubborn, possessing a strong will and a fierce protective instinct for its friends. It famously dislikes its Poké Ball, preferring to travel on Ash's shoulder, always ready for the next adventure or battle.
